**Claim Summary – TM‑2026‑0061** | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Reference** | TM‑2026‑0061 | | **Tenant** | Thornfield Mutual | | **Policy Number** | TM‑CP‑118460 | | **Policyholder** | Halstead Joinery Limited | | **Class** | Commercial property – fire | | **Incident Date** | 2 April 2026 | | **Notified Date** | 2 April 2026 | | **Current Status** | **Open** | | **Reserve (GBP)** | £214,000 | | **Paid (GBP)** | £60,000 | | **Handling Note (key points)** | • Large loss – escalated immediately on notification.
• Fire occurred in the dust‑extraction plant; cause identified as a failed bearing.
• Hot‑work permit records supplied and verified.
• Business‑interruption claim running in tandem.
• Re‑insurance team notified on 3 April 2026. | --- ### Next Steps 1. **Finalise Claim Documentation** - Compile all supporting evidence (photos of damage, engineering reports, hot‑work permit logs, re‑insurance correspondence) into a single claim packet and submit to the Large Loss Unit. 2. **Arrange Specialist Inspection** - Deploy the Engineering Surveyor to the Halstead Joinery premises by **15 May 2026** to conduct a detailed loss assessment and verify the reserve amount. 3. **Business‑Interruption Claim** - Coordinate with the Business‑Interruption Team to submit the weekly loss‑of‑revenue calculations (as per the indemnity period of 12 months). Ensure supporting payroll and supplier invoices are attached. 4. **Re‑insurance Follow‑Up** - Follow up with the reinsurer (named in the handling note) to confirm they have received the notification and are preparing to process their share of the claim. Request a copy of their preliminary status update. 5. **Internal Review & Decision** - Schedule a review meeting with the Large Loss Unit (expected **20 May 2026**) to discuss the survey findings, business‑interruption data, and any additional documentation required before a claim settlement decision can be made. 6. **Documentation & Communication** - Draft a case‑note summarising the above steps (status, next actions, responsible parties) and store it in the case file (e.g., `TM-2026-0061/status.md`). Send a summary email to the claims handler and relevant stakeholders outlining the timeline and responsibilities. 7. **Contingency Planning** - If the survey reveals a higher repair cost than the current reserve, prepare a supplemental claim amendment (TM‑2026‑0061‑Add) and initiate any necessary premium adjustments, subject to policy terms. --- **Key Contacts** - **Claims Handler (Large Loss Unit):** [Name/Email] – responsible for coordinating the specialist inspection and final decision. - **Engineering Surveyor:** [Name/Phone] – to be engaged by the 10 May 2026 deadline. - **Re‑insurance Team:** [Name/Phone] – for any pending status or payment queries. Please let me know if you need any of the supporting documents (e.g., the engineering report draft, business‑interruption template) prepared or if you’d like to schedule a meeting for any of the next steps.
